name: Field Marshal's Log
summary: The Field Marshal's Log records Twilight's Hammer movements through the Riverglades. Its whereabouts may help those in Farholde understand enemy movements.

sections.title: The Log
sections.body: Demar Brant in Farholde Keep is waiting for the Field Marshal's Log. Its records track Twilight's Hammer forces moving through the Riverglades, and someone in Farholde wants to see them. The author is nowhere to be found. The notes may help reveal where the enemy has been moving.

sections.title: Farholde's Concern
sections.body: Demar Brant says the notes arrived too late. Farholde already knows the dangers within Sunnyglade, and he is troubled that you have found them there too.

faq.q: What is in the Field Marshal's Log?
faq.answer: The log records the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades.
The author of the Field Marshal's Log is nowhere to be found.

faq.q: Who wants to see the log?
faq.answer: Someone in Farholde wants to see the log. You are asked to deliver it to Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
Its records of Twilight's Hammer movements may help shed light on enemy movements.

faq.q: Where were the Twilight's Hammer forces moving?
faq.answer: The log records Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades.
